title: Zephyrine and the Contact
author: Odile Reyes
blurb: Gideon Oyelaran, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
